title: [WIP] Fix module not found error in Turbopack build
body:
## Fix Missing Dependency in @object-ui/fields Package

The build is failing because `@object-ui/fields` imports from `@object-ui/core` but doesn't declare it as a dependency.

### Plan
- [x] Analyze the issue - fields package imports ComponentRegistry from core but missing dependency
- [x] Add `@object-ui/core` to dependencies in `packages/fields/package.json`
- [x] Install dependencies to ensure proper resolution
- [x] Rebuild the fields package to verify the fix
- [x] Test the site build to confirm resolution
- [x] Code review completed - no issues found
- [x] Security scan completed - no vulnerabilities detected

### Summary
Successfully fixed the module resolution error by adding the missing `@object-ui/core` dependency to the `@object-ui/fields` package. The original build error "Can't resolve '@object-ui/core'" has been completely resolved.
